motds.body: Find the Battle Royale experience that fits! Standard Battle Royale lets players collect resources and build walls, ramps, and structures on the fly. Zero Build removes building, so players can focus on combat and movement. Zero Build is a great place to start!
motds.title: Two Ways to Play

motds.body: At the start of each match, drop from the Battle Bus and aim for a less crowded area. This gives time to loot and gear up before the fight begins… unless you want to kick things off with a bang!
motds.title: Land Smart to Start Strong

motds.body: Keeping track of Shields and Health is critical to survival. Grab and consume Shield Potions as soon as possible, as low Shields means going down faster in a fight. Use healing items like Med Kits to recover Health between encounters, preferably before the next battle begins!
motds.tabTitle: Play Defense with Health and Shields
motds.title: Play Defense with Health and Shields

motds.body: Valuable Chests are scattered across the Island and contain healing items, weapons, and more, with different rarities of Chests providing different qualities of loot. Listen for the shimmering audio cue to track them down!
motds.tabTitle: Open Chests for the Best Loot
motds.title: Open Chests for the Best Loot

motds.body: Wickedly talented Developers have brought their own horrors to life for Fortnitemares! Explore a Collection of spine-chilling Islands, each with its own twist. Face the fear with friends to unlock the Safety in Numbers Quest.
motds.title: Horrors Worth Facing Together

messages.body: Commanders, we've moved the Save the World message of the day to appear when you first log into Fortnite!
messages.title: Message of the day update
